comment: Single source of truth for the engines this repo can run a client on. Read by clients/recipes_test.go (manifest validation), scripts/new-client.sh (scaffold), scripts/validate.sh (which gate to run) and scripts/verify-isolation.sh. Add an engine here first; the code picks it up. `default` names the scaffold default — changing it is a policy decision, not a code change (docs/client-spine.md#choosing-the-engine).

windmill.summary: Default. UI/forms, step-level replay, non-trivial code steps (TS/Python/Go). Costs Postgres, AGPL self-host, EE for SSO/audit.

dagnats.summary: Typed contracts, native approvals, one binary, go test gate. The exception path: --engine=dagnats.

dagu.summary: Level 2 only: script-shaped recurrent jobs, step retry. Not a product surface.
